mythology: In the Shakti Peetha tradition, Sati's neck fell on the Nallamala hill. Bhramaramba is also worshipped through the story of the goddess taking the form of a swarm of bees to defeat Arunasura.
pilgrimage_significance: One enclosure holds two principal sacred destinations: Bhramaramba's Maha Shakti Peetha and Mallikarjuna's Jyotirlinga. The sequence of worship connects the Shiva and Shakti shrines.
historical_notes: The historic court contains the Veerasiro Mandapa of the Reddi period and the Vijayanagara Mukhamandapa. The prakara carries carved animal processions and narrative scenes.
